svg.title: edit_model — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: An invalid request, a stale base or a rejected write fails the call. Otherwise the specification, identification, data profile, compatibility and predictive check groups run in order, each only when its inputs changed; every check failure is saved as a warning, and the model commits with the reports unless the branch moved.

g.text: the body fails the request schema
the attempt is rejected · branch unchanged
re-checks the base and the schema
each treatment's effect on the default outcome
dtype and range · coverage and gaps
model_execution passed · else MODEL_INCOMPLETE or MODEL_NOT_EXECUTABLE
a current panel whose prepared variables match the model · else NO_COMPATIBLE_PANEL
the laws support simulation · else SIMULATION_UNSUPPORTED
every indicator observed, valid levels and support · else NO_COMPATIBLE_PANEL
2+ finite, increasing observation times · else INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATION_TIMES
the first unmet reason is recorded
200 draws · seed 0 · at the panel's observation times
start: the retained joint state, else the initial-state law
Diffrax Heun SDE · true emission laws
C1a fails for the whole model
the other checks are not evaluated
error: the call fails and nothing is saved
check: a failure is saved as a warning
Any unexpected exception fails the call:
no · fit_laws and DT-to-CT do not run
re-runs after any model change, a new panel,
its data profile or new raw data
uses the profile made by prepare_data
re-runs after any change except to the question,
a new panel, a change in its compatibility
